## Cox Proportional Hazards Model

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(limma)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(sva)
library(reshape2)
```

```{r}
load("SKCM.rda") # Ensure this contains query2
fpkm <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")
log_expr <- log2(fpkm + 1)

# Extract batch (Plate ID) from TCGA barcodes
ids <- as.character(colData(query2)$barcode)
batch <- sapply(strsplit(ids, "-"), function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 6) x[6] else NA
})
if (any(is.na(batch))) warning("Some barcodes missing Plate ID")

# Filter genes with zero variance
gene_var <- apply(log_expr, 1, var)
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr[gene_var > 0, ]
```

```{r}
expr_long_before <- melt(log_expr_filtered, varnames = c("Gene", "Sample"), value.name = "Expression")
expr_long_before$Batch <- batch[match(expr_long_before$Sample, colnames(log_expr_filtered))]
```

### Visualizing survival by expression

```{r}
modcombat <- model.matrix(~1, data = data.frame(batch = batch))
combat_expr <- ComBat(dat = as.matrix(log_expr_filtered), batch = batch, mod = modcombat, par.prior = TRUE, prior.plots = FALSE)
```

```{r}

# Distribution After Batch Correction

expr_long_after$Batch <- batch[match(expr_long_after$Sample, colnames(combat_expr))]
```

```{r}
# Cox Proportional Hazards Model
library(dplyr)

# Prepare survival data
surv_data <- colData(query2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    time = as.numeric(paper_CURATED_DAYS_TO_DEATH_OR_LAST_FU), # Convert to numeric
    status = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0) # 1 = event (death), 0 = censored (Alive)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time), time > 0, !is.na(status)) # Remove invalid entries

# Check sample size and survival data
cat("Number of samples with valid survival data:", nrow(surv_data), "\n")
cat("Number of events (deaths):", sum(surv_data$status), "\n")
cat("Summary of survival times:\n")
summary(surv_data$time)

# Subset expression data to match survival samples
combat_expr_t <- t(combat_expr) # Transpose: samples as rows, genes as columns
surv_samples <- intersect(rownames(combat_expr_t), surv_data$barcode)
surv_data <- surv_data[surv_data$barcode %in% surv_samples, ]
combat_expr_t <- combat_expr_t[surv_samples, ]

# Map gene symbols to ENSG IDs
gene_info <- as.data.frame(rowData(query2))
target_genes <- c("BRAF", "NRAS", "TP53", "KIT", "CDKN2A", "PTEN")
melanoma_genes <- gene_info %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% target_genes) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

# Check if genes exist in expression data
available_genes <- melanoma_genes[melanoma_genes %in% colnames(combat_expr_t)]
if (length(available_genes) == 0) {
  warning("None of the specified genes found in expression data. Using top 5 variable genes instead.")
  gene_vars <- apply(combat_expr, 1, var)
  available_genes <- names(sort(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:5]
} else if (length(available_genes) < length(melanoma_genes)) {
  warning("Some genes not found: ", paste(setdiff(melanoma_genes, available_genes), collapse = ", "))
}

# Use only available genes
melanoma_genes <- available_genes
cox_data <- data.frame(
  time = surv_data$time,
  status = surv_data$status,
  combat_expr_t[, melanoma_genes, drop = FALSE]
)

# Fit Cox model for each gene
cox_results <- lapply(melanoma_genes, function(gene) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~", gene))
  cox_model <- coxph(formula, data = cox_data)
  summary(cox_model)$coefficients[1, ] # Extract gene coefficient
})

# Combine results into a data frame
cox_summary <- do.call(rbind, cox_results)
cox_summary <- as.data.frame(cox_summary) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = melanoma_genes,
    Gene_Name = gene_info$gene_name[match(melanoma_genes, gene_info$gene_id)], # Add gene symbols
    HR = exp(coef), # Hazard ratio
    p_value = `Pr(>|z|)`,
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr") # Adjust for multiple testing
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value) # Sort by unadjusted p-value

# Display results
print("Cox model results:")
cox_summary[, c("Gene_Name", "Gene", "HR", "p_value", "FDR")]
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(survival)

# Prepare survival data
surv_data <- colData(query2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    time = as.numeric(paper_CURATED_DAYS_TO_DEATH_OR_LAST_FU), # Main time column
    # Alternative: Uncomment to try different time column
    # time = as.numeric(paper_CURATED_TCGA_DAYS_TO_DEATH_OR_LAST_FU),
    status = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0), # 1 = event (death), 0 = censored (Alive)
    # Optional covariates
    # age = as.numeric(age_at_diagnosis),
    # stage = as.character(ajcc_pathologic_stage),
    # stage = case_when(
    #   grepl("Stage I|Stage II", stage) ~ "Early Stage",
    #   grepl("Stage III|Stage IV", stage) ~ "Advanced Stage",
    #   TRUE ~ NA_character_
    # )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time), time > 0, !is.na(status)) # Minimal filtering
  # Optional: Uncomment to include covariates
  # filter(!is.na(time), time > 0, !is.na(status), !is.na(age), !is.na(stage))

# Check sample size and survival data
cat("Number of samples with valid survival data:", nrow(surv_data), "\n")
cat("Number of events (deaths):", sum(surv_data$status), "\n")
cat("Summary of survival times:\n")
summary(surv_data$time)

# Subset expression data to match survival samples
combat_expr_t <- t(combat_expr) # Transpose: samples as rows, genes as columns
surv_samples <- intersect(rownames(combat_expr_t), surv_data$barcode)
surv_data <- surv_data[surv_data$barcode %in% surv_samples, ]
combat_expr_t <- combat_expr_t[surv_samples, ]

# Map gene symbols to ENSG IDs
gene_info <- as.data.frame(rowData(query2))
target_genes <- c("BRAF", "NRAS", "TP53", "KIT", "CDKN2A", "PTEN")
melanoma_genes <- gene_info %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% target_genes) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

# Option: Add top 10 variable genes for exploration
# gene_vars <- apply(combat_expr, 1, var)
# top_var_genes <- names(sort(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
# melanoma_genes <- unique(c(melanoma_genes, top_var_genes))

# Check if genes exist in expression data
available_genes <- melanoma_genes[melanoma_genes %in% colnames(combat_expr_t)]
if (length(available_genes) == 0) {
  warning("None of the specified genes found in expression data. Using top 5 variable genes instead.")
  gene_vars <- apply(combat_expr, 1, var)
  available_genes <- names(sort(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:5]
} else if (length(available_genes) < length(melanoma_genes)) {
  warning("Some genes not found: ", paste(setdiff(melanoma_genes, available_genes), collapse = ", "))
}

# Use only available genes
melanoma_genes <- available_genes
cox_data <- data.frame(
  time = surv_data$time,
  status = surv_data$status,
  combat_expr_t[, melanoma_genes, drop = FALSE]
)

# Fit Cox model for each gene (minimal model)
cox_results <- lapply(melanoma_genes, function(gene) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~", gene))
  # Optional: Uncomment to include covariates
  # formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~", gene, "+ age + stage"))
  cox_model <- coxph(formula, data = cox_data)
  # Check proportional hazards assumption
  ph_test <- cox.zph(cox_model)
  cat("Proportional hazards test for", gene, ":", ph_test$table["GLOBAL", "p"], "\n")
  summary(cox_model)$coefficients[1, ] # Extract gene coefficient
})

# Combine results into a data frame
cox_summary <- do.call(rbind, cox_results)
cox_summary <- as.data.frame(cox_summary) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = melanoma_genes,
    Gene_Name = gene_info$gene_name[match(melanoma_genes, gene_info$gene_id)],
    HR = exp(coef), # Hazard ratio
    p_value = `Pr(>|z|)`,
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr") # Adjust for multiple testing
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value) # Sort by unadjusted p-value

# Display results
print("Cox model results (minimal model):")
cox_summary[, c("Gene_Name", "Gene", "HR", "p_value", "FDR")]
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Plot hazard ratios for genes with unadjusted p < 0.2 (lenient threshold)
sig_genes <- cox_summary %>% filter(p_value < 0.2)
if (nrow(sig_genes) > 0) {
  ggplot(sig_genes, aes(x = reorder(Gene_Name, HR), y = HR)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = exp(coef - 1.96 * `se(coef)`), ymax = exp(coef + 1.96 * `se(coef)`)), width = 0.2) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Hazard Ratios for Genes (p < 0.2)", x = "Gene", y = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
} else {
  print("No genes with unadjusted p < 0.2")
}
```

```{r}
# Cox Survival Model
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare clinical data
clinical <- colData(query2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = as.numeric(paper_CURATED_DAYS_TO_DEATH_OR_LAST_FU) / 365, # Convert to years
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0), # 1 = death, 0 = censored
    age_diagnosis = as.numeric(age_at_diagnosis) / 365, # Convert to years
    gender = as.factor(gender)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time), survival_time > 0, !is.na(event)) # Minimal filtering

# Check sample size and events
cat("Number of samples with valid survival data:", nrow(clinical), "\n")
cat("Number of events (deaths):", sum(clinical$event), "\n")
cat("Summary of survival times (years):\n")
summary(clinical$survival_time)

# Subset batch-corrected expression data to match clinical samples
combat_expr_t <- t(combat_expr) # Transpose: samples as rows, genes as columns
surv_samples <- intersect(rownames(combat_expr_t), clinical$barcode)
clinical <- clinical[clinical$barcode %in% surv_samples, ]
combat_expr_t <- combat_expr_t[surv_samples, ]

# Map melanoma genes to ENSG IDs
gene_info <- as.data.frame(rowData(query2))
target_genes <- c("BRAF", "NRAS", "TP53", "KIT", "CDKN2A", "PTEN")
melanoma_genes <- gene_info %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% target_genes) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

# Check if genes exist in expression data
available_genes <- melanoma_genes[melanoma_genes %in% colnames(combat_expr_t)]
if (length(available_genes) == 0) {
  warning("None of the specified genes found in expression data. Using top 5 variable genes instead.")
  gene_vars <- apply(combat_expr, 1, var)
  available_genes <- names(sort(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:5]
} else if (length(available_genes) < length(melanoma_genes)) {
  warning("Some genes not found: ", paste(setdiff(melanoma_genes, available_genes), collapse = ", "))
}

# Use only available genes
melanoma_genes <- available_genes

# Create cox_data with clinical and gene expression
cox_data <- data.frame(
  survival_time = clinical$survival_time,
  event = clinical$event,
  age_diagnosis = clinical$age_diagnosis,
  gender = clinical$gender,
  combat_expr_t[, melanoma_genes, drop = FALSE]
)

# Fit Cox model for each gene individually (univariate)
cox_results <- lapply(melanoma_genes, function(gene) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(survival_time, event) ~", gene))
  cox_model <- coxph(formula, data = cox_data)
  # Check proportional hazards assumption
  ph_test <- cox.zph(cox_model)
  cat("Proportional hazards test for", gene_info$gene_name[gene_info$gene_id == gene], 
      ":", ph_test$table["GLOBAL", "p"], "\n")
  summary(cox_model)$coefficients[1, ]
})

# Combine univariate results
cox_summary <- do.call(rbind, cox_results)
cox_summary <- as.data.frame(cox_summary) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = melanoma_genes,
    Gene_Name = gene_info$gene_name[match(melanoma_genes, gene_info$gene_id)],
    HR = exp(coef), # Hazard ratio
    p_value = `Pr(>|z|)`,
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr") # Adjust for multiple testing
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

# Display univariate results
print("Univariate Cox model results:")
cox_summary[, c("Gene_Name", "Gene", "HR", "p_value", "FDR")]

# Fit multivariate Cox model with all genes and clinical covariates
formula_multivariate <- as.formula(
  paste("Surv(survival_time, event) ~", 
        paste(melanoma_genes, collapse = " + "), "+ age_diagnosis + gender")
)
cox_model_multivariate <- coxph(formula_multivariate, data = cox_data)
cox_summary_multivariate <- summary(cox_model_multivariate)

# Check proportional hazards for multivariate model
ph_test_multivariate <- cox.zph(cox_model_multivariate)
cat("Proportional hazards test for multivariate model (GLOBAL p-value):", 
    ph_test_multivariate$table["GLOBAL", "p"], "\n")
```
